about.description: ANTHROPICX is a private-company perpetual listed on Kraken, tracking Anthropic, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Kraken prices this market off the Backed xStock token for Anthropic, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 5x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
